subject: Social Media
title: Memes as Political Weapons
description: Learn Memes as Political Weapons in one minute.

hook.text: In 2016, Pepe the Frog became a hate symbol. A harmless cartoon weaponized through meme culture.

buildup.text: Political operators discovered memes bypass critical thinking. You laugh first, analyze never.

discovery.text: Russia's Internet Research Agency mass-produced memes targeting U.S. voters. Cheap, effective, deniable.

twist.text: Both sides use memes now. The format is neutral—it amplifies whatever message fits the template.

climax.text: Memes are hard to regulate. They're satire, parody, and propaganda simultaneously. The law can't keep up.

punchline.text: A joke can do what a speech cannot.

quiz.question: Why are memes effective as political tools?
options: They bypass critical thinking through humor
